mechanics.whenRead: PAUSE. Drawn during step 2 of March setup, which stops on this card. Read side B during step 2 at the end of the first March game, then continue the Legacy deck.
rules: Open doors K, 24, 47, and E immediately.
mechanics.notes: The four ids are each in a white box with red type. K and E are lettered doors. What is inside those doors is not printed on this card.
